# uma.moe

> Mobile-first Umamusume database, Veteran workspace, race analysis, timeline, community data, and planning tools for the global version.

## Site navigation

### Main

- [Home](https://uma.moe/): Task-oriented start page and recent activity.
- [Database](https://uma.moe/database): Search characters, support cards, skills, factors, and inheritance data.
- [Veterans](https://uma.moe/veterans): Import, persist, filter, and reuse Veteran rosters across tools.
- [Race Lab](https://uma.moe/race-lab): UmaLogs, single-race replay, and multi-race analysis.
- [Timeline](https://uma.moe/timeline): Estimated global release schedule.

### Community

- [Clubs](https://uma.moe/circles): Club database and fan progression.
- [Rankings](https://uma.moe/rankings): Global trainer fan rankings.
- [Activity](https://uma.moe/activity): Trainer and community activity analytics.

### Tools

- [Tools](https://uma.moe/tools): Planning, statistics, and analysis utilities.
- [Statistics](https://uma.moe/tools/statistics): Global game and player statistics.
- [Lineage Planner](https://uma.moe/tools/lineage-planner): Plan inheritance trees with reusable Veterans.
- [Tierlist](https://uma.moe/tierlist): Support card tierlists.

### System

- [Connect client](https://uma.moe/connect): Pair the future desktop client for ephemeral live data and optional cloud saves.

## Machine-readable navigation

- [Feature metadata](https://uma.moe/meta/features.json)
- [Route navigation graph](https://uma.moe/meta/navigation.json)
- [Schema.org navigation](https://uma.moe/meta/navigation.jsonld)

## Data and privacy

Public metadata never contains private account, Veteran, race, or standalone-client payloads. Authentication is required before account-owned data is requested.
